diverge_patching_autofine
void diverge_patching_autofine(
diverge_model_t* 
mod,
mom_patching_t* 
patch,
const 
double* 
E,
index_t 
nb,
index_t 
ngroups,
double 
alpha,
double 
beta,
double 
gamma
)
alpha

(|E-E_min|/|E_max-E_min|)^alpha is used to calculate group index g

beta

(1-g/#g)^beta is used to calculate number of clusters in group g

gamma

if gamma < beta * #g use all points in cluster

uses internal energy array if NULL is provided for E
